headline: KGI Financial Earns NT$36.29 Billion in First Eight Months; Life Insurance and Securities Both Hit Record Highs, Banking Confident of Meeting Annual Target - Liberty Finance
summary: KGI Financial reported August after-tax profit of NT$5.761 billion and cumulative first-eight-month profit of NT$36.29 billion. Life insurance and securities units both reached record highs.
why: KGI Financial is a Taiwan-listed financial holding company with banking, securities and insurance units. Its monthly results indicate earnings momentum in Taiwan's financial sector.
